screening_decisions.reason: Randomised controlled trial comparing mobilisations (manual therapy) vs other interventions in patients with frozen shoulder. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, manual therapy intervention.
Observational study on incidence and management of shoulder disorders in general practice. Not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial. Does not meet study design criteria.
Educational article summarizing principles from textbooks on joint mobilization. Not a primary research study or RCT. Does not meet study design criteria.

Open randomized controlled trial comparing physical therapies alone vs physical therapies plus arthrography with steroid in frozen shoulder. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, exercise intervention.
Systematic review methodology paper about selective reporting of RCTs. Not a primary RCT on frozen shoulder treatment. Does not meet study design or population criteria.

Randomized controlled trial investigating deep transverse friction massage and capsular stretching (manual therapy) in idiopathic adhesive capsulitis. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, manual therapy intervention.

Randomized controlled trial comparing two exercise programs (glenohumeral ROM exercises vs scapulothoracic exercises) in frozen shoulder patients. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, exercise intervention.

Randomized multiple-treatment trial comparing three mobilization techniques (ERM, MRM, MWM) in frozen shoulder syndrome. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, manual therapy intervention.

Study comparing PNF movement patterns to conventional exercises in chronic peri-arthritis (frozen shoulder). While randomization not explicitly stated, appears to be a comparative intervention study. Include to verify study design at full-text review.

Randomized pilot study comparing antero-posterior vs postero-anterior glide mobilization in adhesive capsulitis. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, manual therapy intervention.
Cross-sectional prevalence study of musculoskeletal disorders in general population. Not an RCT or intervention study. Does not meet study design criteria.
Multiple-subject case report, not a randomized controlled trial. Does not meet study design criteria.

Placebo-controlled randomized trial comparing corticosteroid injection, supervised physiotherapy, combination, and placebo in adhesive capsulitis. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, exercise/physiotherapy intervention.

Randomized placebo-controlled trial comparing manual therapy and directed exercise vs sham ultrasound following joint distension in adhesive capsulitis. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, manual therapy and exercise intervention.
Observational study evaluating responsiveness of a measurement tool (SDQ). Not an RCT or intervention study. Does not meet study design criteria.

Study comparing physical therapy, acupuncture, and combination therapy in frozen shoulder patients. While randomization not explicitly stated, appears to be a comparative intervention study. Include to verify study design at full-text review.
Systematic review and cost-effectiveness analysis. Not a primary RCT. Does not meet study design criteria.

Study comparing anterior vs posterior glide mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis. While randomization not explicitly stated in abstract, appears to be a comparative intervention study. Include to verify study design at full-text review.
Methodology paper examining outcome reporting bias in systematic reviews. Not a primary RCT on frozen shoulder treatment. Does not meet study design or population criteria.
Abstract describes a study on multiple sclerosis and social role performance, not frozen shoulder. The title and abstract do not match. Does not meet population criteria.

Randomized clinical trial comparing corticosteroid injection, physiotherapy, and combination therapy in frozen shoulder patients. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, exercise/physiotherapy intervention.

Randomized controlled trial comparing Cyriax approach (deep friction massage and mobilisation exercises) vs conventional physical therapy in adhesive capsulitis. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, manual therapy intervention.
Prospective observational study describing natural history of frozen shoulder. Not an RCT or intervention study. Does not meet study design criteria.
Methodology paper on heterogeneity in meta-analysis. Not a primary RCT on frozen shoulder treatment. Does not meet study design or population criteria.
Book chapter on addressing reporting biases. Not a primary RCT on frozen shoulder treatment. Does not meet study design or population criteria.
Prospective observational study describing natural history, not an RCT. No intervention comparison.
RCT with 20 patients randomized to mobilization+exercises vs exercises alone. Population has adhesive capsulitis. Outcomes include pain and ROM.
RCT with 90 patients randomized to 4 groups including physical therapy modalities. Population has adhesive capsulitis. Outcomes include pain, ROM, function.
EMG study comparing muscle activity, not an intervention trial. Population not specifically adhesive capsulitis.
Study focuses on chronic shoulder pain in general, not specifically adhesive capsulitis.
RCT with 20 patients randomized to steroid injection vs physical therapy+NSAIDs. Population has adhesive capsulitis.
Textbook chapter about interpreting results, not a primary research study.
Retrospective study, not an RCT or quasi-RCT.
RCT comparing two manual therapy techniques in adhesive capsulitis. Both interventions are manual therapy.
Textbook chapter about presenting results, not a primary research study.
Epidemiological study of consultation patterns, not an intervention trial.
RCT comparing iontophoresis and phonophoresis, not manual therapy or exercise interventions.
RCT with 62 patients randomized to steroids, physiotherapy, or both. Population has painful stiff shoulder (likely adhesive capsulitis).
RCT with 70 patients randomized to electroacupuncture+exercise, interferential electrotherapy+exercise, or no treatment. Population has frozen shoulder.
RCT with 122 patients randomized to physical therapy+ibuprofen vs ibuprofen alone. Population has adhesive capsulitis.
RCT with 22 patients randomized to end range mobilization+exercises+ultrasound vs exercises+ultrasound alone.
RCT with 20 patients randomized to anterior vs posterior glide mobilization. Population has adhesive capsulitis.
RCT with 80 patients randomized to 4 groups including physiotherapy alone and physiotherapy+injection.
RCT with 72 patients randomized to manipulation under anaesthesia, injection, or physiotherapy.
Systematic review, not a primary RCT.
Textbook chapter about meta-analysis methods, not a primary research study.
RCT with 120 patients with adhesive capsulitis comparing joint mobilization and self-exercise.
RCT with 8 patients randomized to chiropractic manipulation+exercise vs mobilization+exercise.
RCT with 100 patients randomized to high-grade vs low-grade mobilization techniques.
RCT with 14 patients randomized to mobilization+home care vs home care alone after corticosteroid injection.
